instructions.manual_exchange_notice: Manual exchange only: upload the single PLANNER_PACKAGE JSON. Nothing is uploaded by VideoHoarder.

priority_order: channel or category only as a secondary signal
quality_rules: Create specific, meaningful groups; prefer a precise topic bucket over a broad umbrella.
Do not group unrelated videos merely because they share a channel, theme, category, or generic word.
Avoid broad keyword-only grouping: use title plus description context and never decide from words such as healthy, product, food, body, tips, best, review, or routine alone.
Split a broad group into natural smaller cohorts even when each resulting group is below the maximum size.
Do not create arbitrary Group 1 or Group 2 splits merely because a group is large. First split by natural subtopic; use numbered size splits only when a truly coherent topic still exceeds its limit.
Every video in a group must share the research context expressed by its self-explanatory group_name and group_reason.
Use Miscellaneous only as a rare last resort after attempting a specific placement for every outlier.
Keep transcript-available and no-transcript videos in their required separate group arrays.
illustrative_buckets: home workouts, gym basics, or yoga
posture, mobility, body-shaping, or fitness myths
weight loss, fat loss, cravings, or metabolism
food habits, produce safety, or wrong eating practices
unsafe foods, household risks, or misleading health claims
disease warning signs or organ health
vitamins, minerals, immunity, or deficiency signs
packaged-food rankings or consumer nutrition reviews
homemade dairy, sprouts, or pantry recipes
snacks, drinks, desserts, or quick recipes
full meals, full-day eating, or practical diet plans
sleep, habits, motivation, or mind wellness
final_validation_checklist: Every manifest VIDEO_ID appears exactly once.
No VIDEO_ID is invented, changed, omitted, or duplicated.
Each transcript group contains at most 25 IDs.
Each no-transcript group contains at most 50 IDs.
Every group contains group_name, group_reason, grouping_basis, recommended_profile, and video_ids.
Every grouping_basis is one of the allowed_grouping_basis values.
grouping_quality_rubric.important_note: Illustrative buckets are examples, not a fixed taxonomy. Create more precise names when the catalog supports them. Topic coherence is more important than filling a group to its maximum.

instructions.instructions: Group every video into a tight, useful research cohort using only the supplied title, description and categories. Follow grouping_quality_rubric exactly. The app, not ChatGPT, decides transcript availability. All catalog IDs must occur exactly once in the correct group type. Give each group a specific self-explanatory name, a substantive reason, grouping_basis, and its recommended profile.
